workflow_defect.title: The daily /plan/ refresh job could not succeed on any run that wrote a re-check result

evidence.failing_step: Verify the generators still reproduce every dataset and page
evidence.cause: That step ran `python3 scripts/build-site.py --check` after the preceding steps had appended to site-data/change-report.json and site-data/schedule-diff.json. plan/flagged.html renders both files, so on any day the re-check wrote a result the committed page no longer reproduced and the check failed; the later commit step was then skipped. `git log --all -- site-data/change-report.json` is empty, i.e. no run has ever committed a report.
evidence.reproduced_locally: With a change-report.json present, `python3 scripts/build-site.py --check` prints 'BUILD FAILED: - regenerated output differs from the committed page: flagged.html' and exits 1; the same two files also broke plan-verify.yml's `git diff --cached --quiet -- plan site-data` gate.

fix: plan-refresh.yml now re-renders plan/ from the datasets after the fetch (`python3 scripts/build-site.py`) and then runs `python3 scripts/check_plan_fresh.py`, which gates plan/** on reproducibility from the published dataset and validates the two run reports for shape.
plan-verify.yml excludes the three run artefacts (change-report.json, schedule-diff.json, snapshots/**) from the committed-dataset diff, re-renders, and runs the same checker with --strict.
